title: London council rejects 1,060-home plan after affordable housing cut to 12%
description: Southwark Council's planning committee voted unanimously against Berkeley Homes' revised plans for the Bermondsey Place development. The housebuilder proposed reducing affordable housing from 40 percent to just 12 percent, causing strong local opposition. Council members expressed concerns about the long timeline for home completion and questioned the developer's financial figures. Berkeley Homes highlighted rising costs and council fees as reasons for the reduced affordable housing offer.

title: ‘Thank you, Test Cricket’: Shami retires from longest format of the game
description: Mohammed Shami announced his retirement from Test cricket on Friday, exactly 13 years after making his debut against West Indies in 2013. The 36-year-old fast bowler signed off with 229 wickets from 64 Tests, including six five-wicket hauls. Shami last played a Test in June 2023 against Australia, sharing an emotional farewell message on Instagram.

title: Olympics once awarded medals for poetry; 1912 gold went to founder under 2 fake names
description: The Olympic Games once awarded gold medals for poetry, music, architecture, painting and sculpture alongside traditional sporting events. Introduced at Pierre de Coubertin’s insistence in 1912, the artistic competitions even saw the Olympic founder secretly win a literature gold medal under two assumed names. However, amateurism rules and declining interest eventually brought the unusual tradition to an end after the 1948 London Olympics.

title: Fears Starlink, builds one of its own: Russia rushes to scale up Rassvet
description: Russia's Security Council has called for the rapid expansion of its satellite communications network, Rassvet, to counteract Starlink. The country has launched 32 satellites this year to support military communications in Ukraine. The network currently struggles with limited coverage and intermittent service over specific areas. Russian officials have highlighted security risks posed by Western satellite services operating over sovereign territories.

title: CBSE Class 10, 12 Board Exams 2027 datesheet released; exams begin February 16
description: The CBSE has released the 2027 datesheet for Class 10 and 12 board examinations, scheduled from February 16 to March 9. More than 45 lakh students have registered for the examinations across 204 subjects. All papers will begin at 10:30 am. The board said it considered major entrance examination schedules while preparing the timetable.

title: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's meteoric rise continues as Bihar hand him captaincy at 15
description: At just 15 years old, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has been named the captain of the senior cricket team for Bihar. The Bihar Cricket Association revealed the squad for the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, featuring 17 players, with Suraj Kashyap as vice-captain. The team's journey kicks off on November 14, following Sooryavanshi's standout performances in both the Indian Premier League and international T20 cricket.

title: Elon Musk: Tesla to end Texas Cybertruck production to make way for Cybercab
description: Elon Musk announced that Tesla will reduce Cybertruck production around mid-2027 to increase Cybercab output. Sales of the Cybertruck have been significantly below initial forecasts, prompting this decision. The Cybertruck faced multiple recalls and price adjustments since its launch in late 2023. Regulatory scrutiny is ongoing for the Cybercab, Tesla's centerpiece in its autonomous vehicle strategy. Despite the wind-down, Musk maintains that the Cybertruck was a remarkable technological achievement.

title: When Air Canada jet ran out of fuel at 41,000 feet in 1983: How all 69 survived
description: On July 23, 1983, an Air Canada Boeing 767 experienced a loss of engine power while traversing over Manitoba. With 61 passengers and 8 crew aboard, a serious fuel miscalculation by ground staff resulted in a 45 percent shortage. Remarkably, the pilots managed to glide the aircraft and executed an emergency landing on an old military track. Thankfully, everyone onboard suffered only minor injuries, and the plane was later restored.

After the initial murder, he reportedly invited his brothers-in-law and later killed them with the same weapon. The bodies are believed to have been hidden in different locations around the city. Investigators are currently exploring whether he acted alone or had assistance. Search operations for the remaining victims continue amidst ongoing police investigations.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ $8 million Missouri estate: Inside his eight-acre luxury compound

The estate includes a private football field, a pool, and a gym designed for family use. Mahomes has a Texas home for the off-season, but Belton serves as the family's base during football season.
